name: VerticalMultiBarChart
intent: The VerticalMultiBarChart component is a complete chart visualization for grouped multi-bar data. It combines ChartHeader, ChartLegend, DataDisplay, VerticalMultiBarGroup, and ChartFooter to create a full chart with title, subtitle, legend, data summary, bars, and footer. It supports up to 3 bar series per category (with auto-generated legend), accepts both canonical (`ChartSeriesDataPoint[]`) and legacy (`MultiBarDataPoint[]`) data formats, and is ideal for comparing multiple data series.
